function.name: protein_info_get_sequence_and_3D
function.description: Retrive the sequence and 3D models of proteins. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

model_3d.description: Set true to get 3D model of the protein.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to retrieve protein sequences and 3D models for human HbA1c, normal hemoglobin, and rat hemoglobin. They want the sequences and 3D models. We have a tool function to retrieve sequence and 3D models. We need to call the function for each protein. The function expects protein_name string and optional model_3d boolean. The default is true. So we can call it with just the name.

We need to produce a response that includes the sequences and 3D models. The function returns any. We need to call the function for each protein. The user didn't specify which normal hemoglobin: maybe human normal hemoglobin? But they said "normal hemoglobin" maybe refers to human normal hemoglobin (HbA). And "rat hemoglobin" presumably rat hemoglobin. So we need to call for "Human HbA1c", "Human HbA", "Rat hemoglobin". Or maybe "Human HbA1c", "Human HbA", "Rat Hb". Let's decide names: "Human HbA1c", "Human HbA", "Rat hemoglobin".

We need to call the function three times. The function returns data. We need to output the results. We'll call the function for each. Use the tool.
